description: Fork of exp659 (no resid, d_v=64, 6-head out_proj = 1.4820 @ 86.51M). Single change: v_tph 128 -> 512 (4x more v_lut tables). Per-layer v_lut weights 6*128*64*64=3,145,728 -> 6*512*64*64=12,582,912 (+9.44M/layer, +56.62M total). Matches exp611's v_lut shape exactly (NAP=6, tph=512, d_v=64). Expected total params ~143.13M. Tests whether v_lut capacity matters at this scale (exp611 had this with much else bigger too). Reference: exp659 = 1.4820 (v_tph=128, 86.5M), exp650 = 1.4825 (w/resid, 86.5M), exp611 = 1.4048 (289M big, v_tph=512), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
